## How it works

- [statement] When KV cache size exceeds available headroom during extended context ingestion, Ollama dynamically reallocates context buffers, incurring allocation stalls unless context size is pinned via num_ctx in Modelfile. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md · keywords: Ollama Architecture and GGUF Memory-Mapping · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/gguf.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] GGUF format structures model weights into contiguous tensor buffers aligned to 32-byte boundaries, enabling zero-copy mmap() loading directly into virtual memory pages. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/gguf.md · keywords: Ollama Architecture and GGUF Memory-Mapping · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md
- [statement] On Apple Silicon macOS, Ollama orchestrates llama-server instances allocating shared Metal command buffers, mapping unified memory buffers without host-to-device PCIe serialization. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md · keywords: Ollama Architecture and GGUF Memory-Mapping · also: https://developer.apple.com/metal/
- [statement] Quantization schemes such as Q4_K_M and Q8_0 balance tensor weight compression against perplexity degradation by utilizing mixed precision blocks for attention projection matrices. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/gguf.md · keywords: Ollama Architecture and GGUF Memory-Mapping · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md
